## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/future-site-ai/cvolve/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] `make test` and `make stan` pass.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the behaviour I changed.
- [ ] Template-engine changes are in `packages/template-kit`, not in the app.
- [ ] Any AI change to a CV goes through `CvToolbox` → `ProposalManager` (the user approves it).
- [ ] I updated the README or docs if setup or behaviour changed.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, `.env.local`, `.env.docker` or personal data.
